newsitem.title: UK: Bradford & Bingley to cut jobs after review.
newsitem.headline: Bradford & Bingley to cut jobs after review.

text.p: The Bradford and Bingley Building Society said on Tuesday it expects to employ fewer staff as a result of an 18-month review of its operations.
But a spokesman for the society denied a press report that it will cut as many as 1,000 jobs from a current total of around 4,000.

The spokesman said the society had told its staff last week that it was reviewing its operations and looking at the cost base. It expects to lose staff by natural wastage in some areas but also expects to expand especially in the area of providing financial advice.
"This is an overall strategy for growth, there will be no compulsory redundancies.
At the half-year, Bradford & Bingley reported assets of 16.3 billion stg. Its pre-tax profits dropped to 62.7 million stg from 79.8 million in the same period last year.
The society will be Britain's second largest mutually-owned building society when larger societies float on the stock exchange next year.
The society spokesman said it remains completely committed to retaining its mutual status. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
